#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main()
{
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::vector<int> t(110, 0);
    int nr = 0;

    while (m > 0)
    {
        nr++;
        t[nr] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++)
    {
        if (t[i] > w / 2)
        {
            t[i] = t[i] - w;
            t[i + 1]++;
        }
    }

    if (t[nr] == 1)
        nr++;

    bool possible = true;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nr; i++)
    {
        if (t[i] > 1)
        {
            possible = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << (possible ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
